messages:
Ethan: Hot take thread  what weird food combo do you actually love? Not the 'lol it's fine' kind, the "I will order this alone at 2am" kind. :thinking_face:
Priya: Cottage cheese + jam. My grandma's blasphemy turned comfort food. :yum:
Nora: Peanut butter + pickles. I know, I know. Crunch + tang = chef's kiss. :peanuts::cucumber:
Sam: Cold pizza + ketchup. Fight me. :pizza::ketchup:
Felix: Banana + mayo sandwich. Old Southern energy. Also surprisingly good with a sprinkle of cinnamon. :banana::mayonnaise:
Ethan: I made a batch of miso + peanut butter noodles once and it saved a rainy weekend. I'll never go back. Recipe if anyone wants. :bowl_with_spoon:
Priya: YES recipe plz. I'm intrigued. :eyes:
Felix: Also microwaved sushi (dont ask) is a petty crime but comfort. :sweat_smile:
snack-bot: Snack poll created  react with :one: for cottage cheese + jam, :two: for PB + pickles, :three: for cold pizza + ketchup, :four: for banana + mayo, :five: for miso+peanut noodles, :six: for guilty microwave sushi
Nora: Adding: apple slices + sharp cheddar -> underrated combo. :apple::cheese_wedge:
Sam: If miso+pb recipe is easy I'm making it tonight. My vote on the poll is :five:.
Priya: Tally so far (unsolicited): :one: x1, :two: x1, :five: x1. This is getting delightfully chaotic. :confetti_ball:
Ethan: Quick recipe: whisk 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp miso, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, warm water to loosen. Toss with noodles, scallions, chili flakes. Add roasted veg if you're fancy. Minimal dishes. :spoon: :fire:
Felix: Will try tomorrow. If this ruins my kitchen it's on you, Ethan. :grimacing:
Nora: Whoever wins poll brings their combo (or evidence of trying it) to the kitchen for taste test. Stakes are high. :rocket:
